long_biography.plain_text:
Svetakov began importing electronics from Asia while studying engineering and used that trading business as the base for Absolut Bank. He co-founded the bank in 1993, expanded it beyond its original captive role and sold it to KBC for USD 1.4 billion. Banking created the decisive pool of capital, but it did not remain his principal business.

He redirected Absolut Group towards land ownership and residential and commercial development, with projects concentrated around Moscow and New Moscow. The holding has also operated insurance and other businesses, but recent activity places real estate at its centre. Svetakov remains the group's founder and chairman, combining strategic ownership with long-term support for the Absolute Help foundation.
